component.subject: Eucharist
component.title: Self-Examination
component.source: W. E. Orchard, The Order of Divine Service (1921), A Simple Observance of the Lord's Supper, p. 116 (Matthew 26:20-22). Lightly modernised.

original.p: Now when even was come, he was sitting at meat with the twelve disciples; and as they were eating, he said, Verily I say unto you, that one of you shall betray me. And they were exceeding sorrowful, and began to say unto him every one, Is it I, Lord?

block.p: Now when evening had come, he was sitting at the table with the twelve disciples; and as they were eating, he said, Truly I say to you, one of you will betray me. And they were exceedingly sorrowful, and every one began to say to him, Is it I, Lord?
